sources.title: 8 Tips for Writing a Resume
supported_principles: select relevant evidence for each role
do not change dates or invent skills and accomplishments
sources.limits: General advice, US-oriented. Do not adopt its broad claim that all online resumes must pass software keyword screening: actual workflows vary. Page count and summary recommendations are contextual, not hard gates.

sources.title: Career toolkit: Crafting an effective resume
supported_principles: paid and unpaid projects can demonstrate relevant skills

sources.limits: US university context; qualitative accomplishment can be excellent without a number.

sources.title: Unsuccessful resume parse
supported_principles: image resumes and complex layout can cause partial or failed extraction
verify extracted fields and reading order
Greenhouse documents a 2.5 MB parsing limit
sources.limits: Greenhouse-specific, not all ATS. Parse failure leaves an attachment and can require manual entry; it does not establish automatic rejection. Do not fabricate legal suffixes or job titles to satisfy parser hints.
